scientific_integrity: Analytic proof; independent direct enumeration tests performed with exact fractions; finite checks do not establish a universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact factor only for four distinct real-line reports and three Product-Gap facilities; nonattained supremum. Independent validation not performed; equivalent unindexed work remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp \(5/2\) approximation at the first positive-cost population for the three-facility Product-Gap rule
